parameters.name: Channels.AliIM
parameters.description:
The TradeManager ID of the alert contact.

Specify at least one of the following alert notification methods: email address and DingTalk chatbot.

parameters.name: Channels.DingWebHook
parameters.description:
The webhook URL of the DingTalk chatbot.

Specify at least one of the following alert notification methods: email address and DingTalk chatbot.

parameters.name: Channels.Mail
parameters.description:
The email address. After you add or modify an email address, the recipient receives an email that contains an activation link. The system adds the recipient to the list of alert contacts only after the recipient activates the email address.

Specify at least one of the following alert notification methods: email address and DingTalk chatbot.

parameters.name: Channels.SMS
parameters.description:
The phone number of the alert contact. After you add or modify a phone number, the recipient receives a text message that contains an activation link. The system adds the recipient to the list of alert contacts only after the recipient activates the phone number.

Specify at least one of the following alert notification methods: email address and DingTalk chatbot.

parameters.name: ContactName
parameters.description: The name of the alert contact.

parameters.name: Describe
parameters.description: The description of the alert contact.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language in which the alert information is displayed. Valid values:

*   zh-cn: simplified Chinese
*   en: English

>  If you do not specify this parameter, CloudMonitor identifies the language of the alert information based on the region of your Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cms put-contact --contact-name Alice --describe ECS_Instance --channels-sms 13333330000 --channels-mail test@aliyun.com --channels-ali-im Jim --channels-ding-web-hook https://oapi.dingtalk.com/robot/send0access_token=7d49515e8ebf21106a80a9cc4bb3d247771305d52fb15d62012345650000 --lang zh-cn --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cms PutContact --region cn-hangzhou --Describe ECS_Instance --Channels.Mail 'test@aliyun.com' --Channels.SMS 13333330000 --Channels.DingWebHook 'https://oapi.dingtalk.com/robot/send0access_token=7d49515e8ebf21106a80a9cc4bb3d247771305d52fb15d62012345650000' --Lang 'zh-cn' --ContactName Alice --Channels.AliIM Jim
